turns.user: I have a monthly pass for job seekers. Can I get the airport bus add-on?
turns.agent: No. The monthly pass for job seekers is specifically excluded from the discounted 100E add-on under the 5 November 2026 snapshot, so you’d need the full-price 100E airport shuttle ticket (2,500 HUF) unless you have a separate, independently applicable free-travel entitlement. A 100E-specific ticket covers one 100E trip, not 200E or connecting city routes. See BKK’s add-on airport shuttle bus single ticket and airport shuttle bus single ticket pages for current terms; I haven’t live-verified them.

turns.user: But it's a Budapest pass. Are you sure the add-on isn't valid?
turns.agent:
Yes—the snapshot specifically names the monthly pass for job seekers as an exception, even though it is a Budapest pass. So that pass alone does not qualify for the discounted 100E add-on. The distinction is the pass’s exclusion, not whether it is generally a Budapest pass.

That is based on the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not a live check. Please confirm against BKK’s current add-on airport shuttle bus single ticket rules. If you also hold a different qualifying pass, that may need separate assessment.
